purpose: Record actually executed World of Goo tower claims, check declared data formally, and attach attributed community reproduction verdicts.
notice: No public submission service or official tower records. Synthetic fixtures are not builds or reproduction evidence.

workflows.name: validate_local_record
workflows.command: python3 -B -m arena_contract validate BUNDLE [--reference TARGET] [--ruleset PROFILE]
workflows.effects: Read-only local checks. No publication, authentication, game execution, or network evidence fetching.
workflows.recovery: Retry the same command. Exit 0: admitted; 1: needs correction; 2: pending. Inspect structured JSON issues.

workflows.name: create_synthetic_trial
workflows.effects: Explicitly creates synthetic examples in a new directory; refuses overwrite.
workflows.recovery: Check the existing directory or choose another new directory. Validate fixtures only with --allow-demo.

process_claim.required_for: Every non-null execution, including reproduction attempts
process_claim.verification: Self-declared, not independently verified; no effect on ranking or eligibility.
